description: Image Description: The image depicts a clean and modern bathroom featuring a bathtub with an integrated shower system. The walls are covered in large, beige-colored tiles with subtle grout lines, creating a warm and neutral atmosphere. The bathtub is white and rectangular, positioned against the back wall of the room. A chrome showerhead is mounted on a vertical bar, allowing for adjustable height, with a flexible hose extending from it to a handheld showerhead. The faucet and controls for the water are located on the left
